title: Ollie Powers and the Dreamland band
summary: The Dreamland band was Ollie Powers's, with Armstrong; Compton calls Powers the best nightclub singer he ever heard.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Who else was in that band, at the Dreamland here?
That was Ollie Piles' band. He was the best nightclub singer I ever heard.
Yeah. Never heard anybody that I thought could sing as good as...
Yes. I never heard anybody sing as good as Ollie. That's the... You, babe?
If you ever had any nightclub boy singing, could beat Ollie singing? No.
